local Recoil = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Weapons.RecoilConfig)

local fields = {
    "VelocityDegPerSec", "MagnitudeVariance", "RecoilAngleDeg",
    "AngleVarianceDeg", "AimPunchScale", "ViewRecoilTracking",
    "ViewPunchExtraFrac", "ViewPunchDecay", "DecayExp",
    "DecayLin", "VelDecay"
}

local function punchee(punch)
    if not punch then return end
    for _, key in ipairs(fields) do
        punch[key] = 0
    end
end

punchee(Recoil.Punch)
Recoil.PatternResetTime = 0

for _, config in pairs(Recoil.Configs or {}) do
    if config.Primary then
        punchee(config.Primary.Punch)
        punchee(config.Secondary.Punch)
    else
        punchee(config.Punch)
    end
    config.PatternResetTime = 0
end

local oldGet = Recoil.Get
Recoil.Get = function(weapon, mode)
    local config = oldGet(weapon, mode)
    if config.Primary then
        punchee(config.Primary.Punch)
        punchee(config.Secondary.Punch)
    else
        punchee(config.Punch)
    end
    config.PatternResetTime = 0
    return config
end

local oldR8Punch = Recoil.r8Punch
Recoil.r8Punch = function(...)
    local punch = oldR8Punch(...)
    punchee(punch)
    return punch
end
